data: Which of the following methods has a HUSE-D of 1 and HUSE-Q of 0.6?

The question asks for a method with a HUSE-D of 1 and HUSE-Q of 0.6. From the caption, we know that the red line represents the best achievable frontier via ensembling. The green square corresponds to the Samp. method. Observing the graph, the Samp. method is located at approximately HUSE-D = 1 and HUSE-Q = 0.6. Therefore, the method with these values is Samp.
